lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cs4Sb2Hg4Se16 crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216) with 26 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Hg and Sb each as octahedral centers with six Se neighbors, while Cs shows a close-packed-like local arrangement with twelve Se neighbors. Corner-sharing is observed between Hg and Sb octahedra and between Cs and Sb polyhedra, with face-sharing also present among Cs and Hg polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 26 sites.
